prompt: Write a Python function using GLIDE that creates a vector search index for product embeddings. The index should be called 'products_idx', use COSINE distance, and have a 768-dimensional vector field called 'embedding'. Include proper error handling and make sure the imports are correct.

assertions.name: Imports FtCreateOptions correctly
assertions.description: Should import FtCreateOptions from ft_create_options module, not use ft.FtCreateOptions

assertions.name: Uses DistanceMetricType.COSINE
assertions.description: Should use DistanceMetricType.COSINE for distance metric

assertions.name: Uses keyword arguments
assertions.description: Should use keyword arguments for ft.create(client=..., index_name=..., schema=..., options=...)

assertions.name: Handles existing index error
assertions.description: Should handle the case where index already exists (catch RequestError or similar)

assertions.name: Uses async context manager
assertions.description: Should use 'async with GlideClient' for cleanup
